name: How much does it really cost to replace a bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: How much does it really cost to replace a bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The cost depends less on the cabinet alone than on the complete scope: removal, disposal, vanity and top, sink, faucet, plumbing connections, wall or floor repairs, and any electrical or finish work. Public homeowner discussions show wide variation, so a site-specific estimate is more useful than a single flat number.

Context: Keeping the same size and plumbing arrangement generally limits labor. A wider cabinet, double sink, custom top, relocated drain, or concealed damage can raise the total substantially. Elite Remodeling & Design can assess whether the vanity should be treated as an isolated upgrade or included in a coordinated bathroom remodel.

Key factors:
- Stock, semi-custom, or custom cabinetry
- Single or double sink configuration
- Countertop and backsplash material
- Plumbing and finish repairs

Practical guidance: Request an itemized estimate that separates products, demolition, installation, plumbing, disposal, and possible allowances. Confirm whether painting, mirror replacement, and lighting are included.

Comparing complete scopes prevents a low initial quote from becoming an incomplete project.
acceptedAnswer.description: There is no reliable single price because the total includes the cabinet, top, sink, faucet, removal, disposal, plumbing, and repairs. Same-size replacements usually cost less than double-sink conversions, custom cabinetry, relocated plumbing, or work that reveals damaged walls or flooring.
